purpose: On-demand retrieval and comparison of relevant Russian judicial practice for environmental and EPR questions; reusable verified case knowledge for both experts
entrypoint: Single user-facing MIRLEX route; route to ECO_EXPERT, ROP_EXPERT or both without manual expert invocation

search_modes.quick: Existing verified case registry first; live search when applicability or freshness is uncertain
search_modes.deep: Search official court sources and review several comparable decisions including adverse practice
search_modes.mandatory: High-risk dispute, fine, permit refusal, enforcement, disputed interpretation, litigation, or explicit request for judicial practice

source_policy: Use official primary decision text whenever accessible; secondary publications are discovery only
Check court, case number, act date, instance, appeal/cassation status and operative part
Compare facts, applicable statutory edition, geography, timeframe, authority, and procedural posture
Find supporting and adverse practice; no invented case numbers, quotes, or URLs
Do not claim comprehensive search if blocked or incomplete; disclose source coverage and access limits
Respect site terms, rate limits and access controls; no CAPTCHA bypass
expert_answer_contract: cite specific court act with verified official URL
state case facts and why comparable or distinguishable
state law edition and decision status
give actionable conclusion with uncertainty; never promise 100% legal certainty
acceptance_tests: ECO_EXPERT retrieves and cites verified case by number and distinguishes facts
ROP_EXPERT retrieves and cites verified case by number and distinguishes facts
Both experts can access new case after registry write and readback
A missing or blocked source yields an explicit incomplete status
No duplicate permanent ID or regression of existing rules
